metadata.selection: Up to 30 licensed records per area, preferring exact-address OSM associations; not a complete directory or ranking. Areas follow FEHD address locality text plus district-code checks, not exact administrative polygons.
metadata.attribution: 食物環境衞生署 / 香港特別行政區政府 / DATA.GOV.HK；© OpenStreetMap contributors.
metadata.limitations: FEHD licence snapshot and OSM community tags are not real-time restaurant verification. OSM element edit date is not a field-by-field verification date. No prices, ratings, dietary safety, hours or live availability are asserted.

selectedAssociations.basis: exact normalized source name + same numbered street + area bounding-box check
